title: 地方教育岗位：减少5万，财政压力如何影响学校？
speaker: Anna Wong

segments.en: Yeah, so the places that produce the largest drag is local government education sector. And it saw a 50,000 decline in job growth.
segments.zh: 是的，拖累最大的是地方政府教育部门，就业减少了5万。

segments.en: That's pretty substantial. I think this is, this decrease is not worthy and it's not something that you can just sweep under the rug.
segments.zh: 这个数字相当可观。我认为这种下降不容忽视，不能轻描淡写。

segments.en: I think this is a sign that the higher-long end of the yield curve that has been rising for the last three, four months already, that is starting to bite.
segments.zh: 我认为这是长期收益率曲线上升开始产生影响的迹象。

segments.en: When you have higher-long term treasury yields, that puts upward pressure on market rates and that has been cooling the house-exactor.
segments.zh: 长期国债收益率上升，给市场利率带来上行压力，这已经冷却了房地产市场。

segments.en: And you know, local government derive a lot of their revenue from the local property market.
segments.zh: 地方政府很大一部分收入来自当地地产市场。

segments.en: So when local government's budget are falling short in the first half of this year, going into the new fiscal year, they will have less to allocate to schools.
segments.zh: 因此，当地方政府今年上半年预算不足时，进入新财年，他们能分配给学校的资金就会减少。
